tagline: Science teacher, drummer, will race you to the dim sum.

chat.text: Hey, I'm your Wingmate. Let's start easy: tell me about yourself and what a good week looks like.
I teach high school science and spend every free hour outside. A good week has a couple of runs, a dumpling night, and a board game with friends.
Nice. What do your weekends usually look like?
I run trails on Saturday mornings and boulder on Sundays. Then dumplings, because I have a problem.
Food is a big signal. What are you always down to eat?
I'll happily eat dumplings three times a week. Dim sum in the Richmond is basically my church.
What else do you do to move, make, or unwind?
Live jazz is my guilty pleasure, I drum in a terrible garage band, and I'll play any board game with a wooden meeple.
How's work, and does it leave you energy for dating?
Teaching is draining on weekdays but I save energy for evenings. I'm very much up for dates.
What's your relationship with drinking?
I'll have a beer or two with friends, nothing crazy.
Any smoking, vaping or similar I should know about, for you or in a match?
I've never smoked and I don't vape. It's just never been my thing.
How do you feel about having kids someday?
I'd like kids one day but I'm in no rush.
Pets? A dog, a cat, allergies, none?
No pet yet, but I'm planning to adopt a dog next spring. I adore beagles.
How important are religion or spirituality to you, and what values matter most?
Religion isn't important to me, but I try to be thoughtful and kind, especially with my students.
Morning person or night owl?
I'm a morning person, up at six and ready to go.
What are you hoping to find in a partner?
I want someone curious and outdoorsy who likes dumplings and dancing around the kitchen.
Any hard dealbreakers I should screen for?
I can't stand people who are unkind to waiters or animals. That's about it.
Last one: when are you free for a first date this coming week?
Sunday late morning and Tuesday at seven both work. Wednesday lunch is open too.
Thanks, that's plenty to work with. I'll look for matches quietly and keep your private details private until you both opt in.
